data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was US$3,213.5m. Using the gross claims development (cumulative incurred claims) triangle the movement on underwriting years prior to 2014 (2011-2013) represents a net adverse development of US$33.8m (approximately 1.05% of opening reserves), driven by mixed development across years (favourable development in 2012 offset by adverse development in 2011 and material adverse development in 2013). No single quantified prior-year event is identified in the notes; the prior-year movement has been calculated from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: reduced levels of favourable ultimate premium development on prior years compared to 2014.

Our overall claims experience in 2015 has been in line with expectations. An increase in the attritional loss ratio from rating pressures and a change in business mix was offset by the absence of major claims for the Syndicate in 2015.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding) prior-year comparative column (explicit). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding (gross)' was presented; prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (Note 9). The 'exact_reserve_text' is a Directors' Report sentence referring to reduced favourable prior-year development (it refers to premium development rather than an explicit gross claims movement). Prior-year development therefore is a calculated figure from the triangle rather than a single explicit gross movement line; amounts are in the report's native currency (USD millions).
